items.summary: Our recent piece, Why Did Take-Two Stock Move?, found that Take-Two Interactive Software (TTWO) shares rose 8.3% on Tuesday, November 10, even though fiscal second-quarter net bookings of $1.6 billion came in below the company's own $1.62 billion to $1.67 billion range. The next question is the one an owner should ask before a big launch: what is the real risk now.
